svg.title: The polar curve r = 3 sin θ + cos(2θ) for θ from 0 to π, with region R shaded
svg.desc: On a polar grid with circles of radius 1 and 2 and rays every π/6, the curve r = 3 sin θ + cos(2θ) is drawn for θ from 0 to π. It starts at (1, 0) on the positive x-axis, rises in a broad arch to a top a little above y = 2, and comes back down to (−1, 0) on the negative x-axis. The region R between the arch and the x-axis is shaded.

text.tspan: r = 3 sin θ + cos(2θ), 0 ≤ θ ≤ π
